title: History 386: Bug 1881153 - Wait for status bar meteors to stop when waiting for connection idle. r=mkmelin This waits until the status bar progress meter is not active and not about to become active whenever promiseServerIdle is called. That should help prevent the status bar getting confused by multiple connections coming and going.
